headerDisplay: HomeKit control of an MG EV via the SAIC iSmart cloud API. Only one iSmart session is allowed at a time, so logging in here will sign the phone app out.
footerDisplay: Set the account password via the MG_SAIC_PASSWORD environment variable instead of pasting it into this form where possible, so it doesn't sit unencrypted in config.json on the NAS.

password.title: iSmart account password
password.description: Leave blank and set MG_SAIC_PASSWORD in the Homebridge environment instead, if possible.

vin.title: Vehicle VIN (optional)
vin.description: Leave blank to use the first vehicle returned by the account. Set this if the account ever returns more than one vehicle, to pin the plugin to the primary MG4.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Poll interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: SAIC's gateway can pause an account for 15 minutes if it sees too many logins. 15 minutes is the documented safe default.

enablePreconditioning.title: Expose cabin pre-conditioning (aircon) as Cabin Heat / Cabin Cool HeaterCoolers
enablePreconditioning.description: The remote aircon / climate control, exposed as two separate HeaterCooler tiles: 'Cabin Heat' (confirmed working on a real MG4) and 'Cabin Cool' (turning it on is refused unless the experimental option below is set: the compressor command was confirmed to heat at maximum on a real MG4). Each has its own target temperature slider, 17 °C to 33 °C on an MG4 (the range follows the vehicle series, see below). Turning one on automatically shows the other as off, since the car only has one underlying climate system. It is also not the pre-drive feature in the newer iSmart apps. See TESTING.md. With this off you get no tile in the Home app at all.

climateMinTemperature.title: Cabin Heat / Cabin Cool slider minimum (°C, optional)
climateMinTemperature.description: Leave blank to pick the range from the vehicle's series code, like saic-python-mqtt-gateway: MG4 (EH32) 17-33 °C, MG S5 (MZS3E) 16-31 °C, any other series 16-28 °C (the MG S6 EV lands here; its real range isn't confirmed), 17-33 °C if the series is unknown. Startup log shows the range in use.

climateMaxTemperature.title: Cabin Heat / Cabin Cool slider maximum (°C, optional)
climateMaxTemperature.description: Leave blank to pick it from the vehicle's series code (see the minimum above). Must be above the minimum.

enableExperimentalCabinCool.title: Experimental: let Cabin Cool start the climate without the compressor flag
enableExperimentalCabinCool.description: NOT confirmed on any real car. When on, turning Cabin Cool on sends the reference client's start_ac (fan 2 and the Cool tile's target temperature, no compressor flag), i.e. the same command as Cabin Heat, and relies on the car to cool towards a target below the cabin temperature. The raw remoteClimateStatus is logged on every change so you can see what the car actually did. Stay near the car the first time. See README.md.

enableDoorSensors.title: Expose door / boot / bonnet contact sensors

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Expose interior/exterior temperature sensors
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Off by default: temperature sensors appear on the iOS lock screen and Home widgets, which looks odd for car temperatures in a home context.

enableHeatedSeats.title: Expose heated seat switches (left/right)
enableHeatedSeats.description: Confirmed working against real hardware. Off by default since it's a newer control, see TESTING.md.

enableRearDefrost.title: Expose rear window defrost switch
enableRearDefrost.description: Confirmed working against real hardware. Off by default since it's a newer control, see TESTING.md.

enableFrontDefrost.title: Expose front window defrost switch
enableFrontDefrost.description: Not yet confirmed against real hardware. Off by default, see TESTING.md.

enableHeatedSteeringWheel.title: Expose heated steering wheel switch
enableHeatedSteeringWheel.description: On/off Switch for cars with a heated steering wheel (e.g. MG S6 EV), ported from the reference client. The car switches it off by itself after about 10 minutes. Not yet confirmed against real hardware by this plugin. Off by default, see TESTING.md.

enableWindowVentilation.title: Expose a window ventilation switch (MG S6 EV format)
enableWindowVentilation.description: One Switch for all four door windows, using the MG S6 EV's window command: on opens them a few centimetres, off closes them. Fully opening is not exposed. Reads on when any door window is open, including one opened by hand. The command format is confirmed on a real MG S6 EV (full open); the ventilate and close actions are not yet. Does not work on the MG4 (see README.md). Off by default.
